notes.text:
An update is available for curl.
This update affects Rocky Linux 10.
A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE list
notes.title: Topic

notes.text:
The curl packages provide the libcurl library and the curl utility for downloading files from servers using various protocols, including HTTP, FTP, and LDAP.

Security Fix(es):

* curl: libcurl: Improper certificate validation due to cached TLS settings reuse (CVE-2025-14819)

* curl: curl: Security bypass due to global TLS option changes in multi-threaded LDAPS transfers (CVE-2025-14017)

* curl: curl: Authentication bypass due to incorrect connection reuse with Negotiate authentication (CVE-2026-1965)

* curl: curl: Unauthorized access due to improper HTTP proxy connection reuse (CVE-2026-3784)

* curl: curl: Information disclosure via OAuth2 bearer token leakage during HTTP(S) redirect (CVE-2026-3783)

* curl: curl: Proxy credential disclosure via redirects to unauthenticated proxies (CVE-2026-6253)

* curl: libcurl: Authentication bypass due to incorrect HTTP Negotiate connection reuse (CVE-2026-5545)

* curl: libcurl: Credential leak via reused proxy connection during HTTP redirects (CVE-2026-6429)

* curl: libcurl: Information disclosure via incorrect Proxy-Authorization header reuse (CVE-2026-7168)

* curl: curl: Man-in-the-middle attack via SSH host key bypass (CVE-2026-9547)

* libcurl: libcurl: Security feature bypass due to improper mTLS connection reuse (CVE-2026-8932)

* curl: curl: Information disclosure via incorrect .netrc password lookup (CVE-2026-8926)

* curl: curl: Insecure connection establishment due to TLS configuration mismatch (CVE-2026-8286)

* curl: libcurl: Unauthorized connection reuse due to a logical error (CVE-2026-8458)

* curl: curl: Cookie injection via malicious HTTP server using super cookies (CVE-2026-8924)

* libcurl: libcurl: Use-after-free vulnerability leading to Denial of Service (CVE-2026-10536)

* curl: curl: Information disclosure via incorrect Digest authentication header reuse (CVE-2026-11856)

* curl: curl: SSH host verification bypass when using schemeless URLs with SFTP/SCP (CVE-2026-12064)

* curl: Information disclosure due to uncleared proxy authentication state (CVE-2026-8927)

* libcurl: libcurl: Information disclosure due to failure to clear proxy authentication credentials (CVE-2026-9079)

* curl: curl: HTTP/2 upload Use-After-Free (CVE-2026-92392)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.

This advisory is provided by Ctrl IQ, Inc for Rocky Linux systems. For more information about CIQ security practices, visit https://ciq.com/security.
